core_backend: db.js - MongoDB connection handler (with graceful fallback)
binanceSocket.js - Real-time price data from Binance
signal_system: models/Signal.js - MongoDB schema with SEO fields (slug, title, description)
services/saveSignal.js - Signal storage with auto-generated metadata
routes/seo.js - Dynamic signal pages with meta tags
routes/sitemap.js - XML sitemap generation for Google

environment_variables.setup_instructions: Add these in Render Dashboard > Environment > Environment Variables

render_deployment.region: recommended: Singapore or closest to Binance servers

how_it_works: 3. Signal stored in MongoDB with SEO metadata
4. routes/seo.js serves signal as HTML page with meta tags
5. routes/sitemap.js lists all signals (up to 50k) for Google
routes: GET /sitemap.xml - XML sitemap for Google indexing

fix_1.solution: Consolidated to single implementation in routes/seo.js

fix_2.issue: MongoDB connection crashes on startup if DB unavailable
fix_2.solution: Made connection optional in db.js, app continues without DB

fix_3.issue: Twitter API initialization fails without credentials
fix_3.solution: Lazy-loaded client (only init if API keys exist)

fix_4.issue: Missing SEO fields in Signal schema
fix_4.solution: Added slug (unique), title, description to models/Signal.js

fix_5.solution: Updated to correct Google Search Console endpoint

testing_before_render_push.note: Test server doesn't require MongoDB or API credentials

monitoring_in_render.expected_output: Server running on port 3000, MongoDB connected (or running without DB), Binance socket listening
common_issues: ⚠️  MongoDB connection failed -> App still runs (designed fallback)
No Telegram messages -> Check TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is correct
No tweets posted -> Check X_API_KEY (optional, can be omitted)
Sitemap returning error -> Check MongoDB connection, may need MONGO_URI

google_search_console_setup.expected_result: Signal pages start appearing in Google search results

git_commit_message: chore: remove test files, restore production config
files_to_delete: .env - local test file (use .env.local as template instead)

2. 📝 Fill in .env variables in Render dashboard

contact_info.telegram: Bot connected and monitoring - signals will auto-notify
